findings.title: test_crisis_settled_scan staging comment contradicts its own 6.3 re-pin (first shed 'bundle 2' vs pinned bundle 0)

Misdiagnosis risk for future re-bless audits.

findings.title: u32 wrap in pipe_effective_capacity: raw × permille unguarded (capacity_units has no upper bound at load)
findings.evidence: return raw * row.legacy_decay_permille / 1000 — raw := u32(cat.pipe_tiers[tier].capacity_units); catalog validates only capacity_units > 0 (catalog.odin:519)
findings.detail: Authoring data ≥ ~4.3M capacity wraps u32 → wrong effective capacity (possibly above raw) with no fail-fast — against the diff's own ODN-5 bar. Shipped tiers (10/15/40) are safe.
findings.fix: Compute in u64, or range-check capacity_units×1000 ≤ max(u32) at pipe_tiers.json load.

findings.title: modernize pipe id: u64 parse narrowed to u32 unchecked — the weights verb's own fixed pattern not followed
findings.evidence: fid, okid := strconv.parse_uint(...); append(... pipe = u32(fid)) — contrast demo.odin's weights guard: 'range-check before the narrowing cast … Fail loud at parse instead' (a prior review finding)
findings.detail: Ids ≥ 2^32 wrap onto a different live pipe (4294967296 → 0) and can bless a wrong-but-self-consistent golden; demolish/emphasis share the flaw (pre-existing), weights shows the intended bar.
findings.fix: Reject fid > max(u32) at parse in the modernize case (and sibling id verbs when touched).

findings.title: testing.expectf(nil, …) inside build() — bites via the logged-error path, but should thread t
findings.detail: Empirically verified: expectf(nil,false,…) fails the test (Odin fails on logged errors) — so not vacuous; but nil-t is misleading style in the story's key measurement test.
findings.fix: Thread t into build() (build :: proc(t, cat, seed, modernize)) and expectf(t, …).

findings.title: pipe_effective_capacity: redundant second era_row lookup + unreachable-false ok guard
